title: Comprehensive single-cell RNA sequencing analysis reveals key immune regulators and signaling pathways in people living with HIV across tissues and cell types.
snippet: To identify shared gene signatures, regulatory networks, and shared molecular regulators associated with HIV infection across tissues and cell types using publicly available single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) datasets from people living with HIV. We systematically analyzed human scRNA-seq datasets from brain, cerebrospinal fluid, blood, adipose tissue,....
